core.headline: New 3-bed semi, Kings Hill – completion spring 2027
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house on this development in Kings Hill, West Malling. Plot 47 is The Larch design with air source heat pump heating and EV charging point. Completion is expected in spring 2027.

The ground floor has a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10") and a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") with underfloor heating throughout. On the first floor there are three bedrooms, the principal measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with an en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside there is a turfed rear garden with patio and two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away.

Fixed Price £410,000 for the freehold with no onward chain. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. EPC B is a predicted rating (SAP); the final EPC will be issued on completion. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.
core.summary: Air source heat pump and EV charging point for this new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house in Kings Hill. The Larch design with 10-year NHBC warranty, en-suite to the principal bedroom, two parking spaces and completion expected spring 2027
